verdict.rationale: Live egress to RTMP or HLS is a fair question for a video SDK, but nothing in the evidence documents streaming a live Room to RTMP or HLS endpoints. Recordings and compositions (docs-8, docs-17) are post-session artifacts built from recorded tracks, not live broadcast egress, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, a live session can be egressed to RTMP or HLS so a large audience watches without joining the session
